sloka: क्षिप्तं दृष्ट्वा ततः कायं सुग्रीवः पुनरब्रवीत् ।लक्ष्मणस्याग्रतो राममिदं वचनमर्थवत् ॥४-११-८६॥।।
transliteration: kṣiptaṁ dṛṣṭvā tataḥ kāyaṁ sugrīvaḥ punarabravīt ।lakṣmaṇasyāgrato rāmamidaṁ vacanamarthavat ॥4-11-86॥।।

translations.english: Having seen Rama flinging the body, Sugriva said to him again in the presence of Lakshmanameaningfully:
